LOYALTY_DISCOUNT = 0.92  # 8% off for loyalty members

def add_order_total(df):
    """Return a copy of df with an order_total column."""
    out = df.copy()
    out["order_total"] = out["quantity"] * out["unit_price"] * LOYALTY_DISCOUNT
    return out

completed = add_order_total(orders[orders["status"] == "complete"])
